# CAD in USD on 2026-01-02, a day the book already prices the other way round.
#
# `prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt` states USD in CAD for that day. GnuCash
# keeps one price a day for two currencies, whichever way round they are
# written (Q-041, table 1), so adding this one would delete that one. The
# source is that price's own, `user:price-editor`: a lower-ranked source would
# be turned away by GnuCash instead, and hide the deletion this is about.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the refusal, which lists the USD in CAD
# price already there.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_second_price_on_one_day_is_refused.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-01-02 18:00:00 +0000"
	value: "0.733"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"
